cohort: The study included 129 gastroschisis patients (from an initial 155, after excluding those with complicated gastroschisis) whose data were reviewed from 2001-2013.
finding: Subsets of gastroschisis patients at increased risk of infection include those with silos, preterm delivery, low birth weight, and sutured repair.
birth_weight: low birth weight (for infected patients), specific weights for the general cohort not mentioned
gest_age: average 35.97 weeks (for the cohort), preterm delivery (for infected patients)
